title: Local-base strict henselization core from a residue-triple colimit
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p\in\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ and $K$ a separable closure of the scheme residue field $\kappa(p)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Write $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$ for its structural embedding. Let $c$ be a universal cocone of the ring diagram of etale residue triples over $(R,p,K,\chi)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples]. Let $C$ be a commutative ring and $e:c.\mathrm{pt}\cong C$ a ring isomorphism. The identity triple $t_0$ is $(R,\mathrm{id}_R,p,\chi)$; put $b_0=e\circ c.\iota(t_0):R\to C$ and $A=R_p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. There exist a field $L$, a separable-closure structure on $L$ over $k_A=A/\mathfrak m_A$, an $A$-algebra structure on $L$ compatible with $A\to k_A\to L$, and an $A$-algebra structure on $C$, such that the composite $R\to A\to C$ is $b_0$ and $C$ is a strict henselization of $A$ relative to $L$ in the pointed-etale colimit sense [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization].

proof.text: For each s outside p apply etaleResidueTriple_unit_refinement to the identity triple. Map the resulting unit along its cocone leg and e; cocone naturality proves that b0(s) is a unit. IsLocalization.lift explicitly constructs A to C and proves its restriction is b0.

Take L=K. Spec.residueFieldIso R p identifies kappa(p) with the residue field of A. Compose its inverse with chi to define the residue-field algebra on K, and compose with the residue map to define A to K. Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv transports separability while separable closedness is unchanged. SpecToEquivOfField supplies the local point and residue embedding with evaluation A to K. Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv proves restriction compatibility on R.

Apply etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_comparison to the explicitly constructed A-algebra structures on K and C, obtaining a universal local-base ring cocone with vertex C and compatible A-structural maps.
Apply etaleResidueTriples_colimit_isStrictHenselization to this cocone. Package L=K, its transported instances and the localization restriction formula to obtain exactly the displayed conclusion.

proof_origin.note: Repair D2: complete Lean proof constructs the localization and field structures, uses the strictly smaller ring-colimit localization comparison and then the existing local-base comparison theorem.

lean.statement: theorem etaleResidueTriples_localized_core (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField p) K] [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField p) K] (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K)))) (hc : IsColimit c) (C : CommRingCat.{u}) (e : c.pt ≅ C) : ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) L) (_ : IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) L) (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) L) (_ : IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) L) (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) C), (∀ r : R, algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) C (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) r) = (c.ι.app ⟨R, 𝟙 R, inferInstance, p, by simp, CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K), by simp⟩ ≫ e.hom).hom r) ∧ Algebra.IsStrictHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) L C
